hypothesis: A four-bit block label selecting one of sixteen frozen vectors of exact rational-odds corrections over bit-position and confidence buckets exposes at least 2000 net bytes per million raw bytes of residual information beyond AF-1 after labels and codebook bytes.
interfaces_exposed: pre-truth AF-1 integer P1, bit position, confidence bucket, paid block label, exact range replay
kill_condition: Retire this frozen 4096-WRT-byte, 16-codeword, 128-bucket, five-rational-correction construction if parent replay differs by one byte or any of the exact-net, holdout, or rotated-null gates fails; do not rescue it with a block-size, codeword-count, bucket, or correction-grid ladder.
promotion_condition: Require exact parent P1 replay, at least 2000 B/M exact net after labels and codebook, at least 2500 B/M chronological holdout surrogate net, at least 1000 B/M over the rotated-label null, then native roundtrip, determinism, source accounting, distant transfer, and canonical 10M net of at least 23KB.
rejection_reason: Exact opening-1M parent replay passed, but PBVC saved only 196 gross bytes and lost 685 net bytes; chronological holdout was -62.878 B/M and real-over-rotated was 419 B/M, failing every frozen gate.
retired_neighborhoods: Distinct from terminal SIBYL scalar page calibration: PBVC selects a vector of 128 conditional rational-odds corrections and uses fixed WRT-byte blocks rather than one page-wide curve.
title: PBVC-1 paid block vector correction codebook
